name: skill-check
description: Warns when a skill is used while out of date. Reads metadata.version / metadata.source from SKILL.md, and knows Spec Kit projects and npx skills installs. Requires Node.js 20 or later.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises GitHub's rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests an hour. A token with no scopes is enough, since skill-check only reads public files. Sent only to api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com. Leave empty if unsure.
